name: expert_aml_rsi
summary: This EA combines an AML (Asymmetric Least Squares Moving Least-squares) indicator with RSI to generate momentum-based trading signals. It enters long positions when AML signals an uptrend and RSI confirms momentum, and enters short positions under the opposite conditions. The EA applies fixed lot sizing and uses AML crossovers along with RSI thresholds for entry and exit decisions.
summary_zh: 该EA结合AML（非对称最小二乘移动均线）指标与RSI指标生成动量交易信号。当AML指示上升趋势且RSI确认动量时做多，反之做空。EA采用固定手数，使用AML交叉和RSI阈值进行入场和出场决策。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念是将非对称最小二乘移动均线（AML）作为趋势方向过滤器，RSI作为动量确认指标。入场条件为：做多时AML线向上交叉且RSI处于超卖区域回升或高于某个阈值，做空时AML线向下交叉且RSI处于超买区域回落或低于某个阈值。出场条件通常依赖于AML反向交叉信号或RSI到达极端区域，部分版本可能包含固定止损止盈。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，没有根据账户余额或风险比例动态调整仓位大小。资金管理方面缺乏高级的风险控制机制，如最大回撤限制、连续亏损后的仓位缩减等。整体策略逻辑清晰，将趋势跟踪与动量确认相结合，但风险管理和仓位管理较为简单。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept combines an Asymmetric Least Squares Moving Line (AML) as a trend direction filter with RSI as a momentum confirmation indicator. Entry conditions: for long positions, the AML line crosses upward and RSI confirms momentum by recovering from oversold levels or exceeding a threshold; for short positions, the AML line crosses downward and RSI declines from overbought levels or drops below a threshold. Exit conditions typically rely on AML reverse crossover signals or RSI reaching extreme zones, with some versions potentially including fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach without dynamic adjustment based on account equity or risk percentage. Money management lacks advanced risk controls such as maximum drawdown limits, position reduction after consecutive losses, or equity-based scaling. The overall strategy logic is clear, combining trend following with momentum confirmation, but risk management and position sizing are relatively simplistic.

pros: 双指标组合（AML+RSI）提供趋势与动量的双重确认，减少假信号
策略逻辑简洁明了，易于理解和参数优化
AML指标对价格噪声有较好的平滑效果，能更准确捕捉趋势转折
pros_en: Dual indicator combination (AML+RSI) provides double confirmation of trend and momentum, reducing false signals
Strategy logic is clean and straightforward, easy to understand and optimize parameters
AML indicator has good noise-smoothing properties, capturing trend reversals more accurately
cons: 固定手数缺乏动态仓位管理，无法根据市场波动调整风险敞口
默认止损止盈为零，存在无止损交易的巨大风险
缺乏连续亏损保护、最大回撤限制等资金管理机制
cons_en: Fixed lot sizing lacks dynamic position management, unable to adjust risk exposure based on market volatility
Default stop-loss and take-profit are zero, posing significant risk of trading without protective stops
Lacks money management mechanisms such as consecutive loss protection or maximum drawdown limits
improvements: 增加动态仓位管理，根据ATR或账户风险比例自动调整手数
添加强制止损机制和最大回撤保护，确保每笔交易都有风险上限
improvements_en: Add dynamic position sizing based on ATR or account risk percentage to automatically adjust lot size
Implement mandatory stop-loss mechanism and maximum drawdown protection to ensure every trade has a risk cap

risk_points: 默认止损止盈为零，可能导致单笔交易无限亏损
无最大回撤保护和连续亏损检测机制
固定手数不考虑账户规模和波动率，极端行情下风险失控
risk_points_en: Default stop-loss and take-profit are zero, potentially leading to unlimited loss on a single trade
No maximum drawdown protection or consecutive loss detection mechanism
Fixed lot size ignores account size and volatility, risking uncontrolled exposure in extreme market conditions
